news.headline: Scientists Find 57 New Animals in an Underwater Canyon
news.body: A robot named SuBastian explored the Mar del Plata Canyon off Argentina, a valley under the sea that is more than twice as deep as the Grand Canyon. Its cameras found coral reefs, sea stars, and animals no person had ever seen. Scientists announced 57 new kinds of sea creatures, including a see-through sea cucumber with horn-like bumps nicknamed Loki. A team plans to explore another canyon in 2027.

news.headline: Webb Telescope Shows Baby Stars Blowing Jets of Gas
news.body: NASA used the James Webb Space Telescope to take a new picture of NGC 7129, a place where stars are being born. Gravity pulls gas together to make stars, and young stars then shoot out powerful jets and winds. Those jets stretch the red gas into long, thin threads. By looking at stars of different ages in one picture, scientists can learn how stars grow up.
